methodology.grading_method: Relative percentile-based binning (histogram). Each model's grade (0-10) is determined by its percentile position in the actual distribution of verified scores.
methodology.demotion_rule: If coding grade exceeds reasoning grade by ≥2 points, model is demoted one class.
